material.description: scripts/perf/first-draw.mjs:30-37 (createReadStream, no content-encoding). Symptom: 1.7 MB wasm and 700 KB json travel raw on loopback; ceiling and variance rows (first-draw-gate-flaky-same-tree) cannot be interpreted. Also line 33 file.startsWith(siteDir) lacks path.sep. Acceptance: server sends gzip for text, js, json, wasm as Pages does and the traversal check uses siteDir + sep; the run prints transferred bytes. Witness: pages first-draw job log.
material.subject: first-draw.mjs serves the site with no gzip or brotli while GitHub Pages compresses, so the measured first draw is not the player's
material.witness: verify-first-draw-server-serves-uncompressed witness RESULT: PASS; CI green on 9d6165006503 (ci 40179272561, pages 40179272563), publishes 220ec688 and 6ac10955
